-- Edited by Harbinger451
-- StartsBy: Script
-- Questee: anyone with a fishing-net
Quest: FishingQuest
DisplayName: Let's Go Fishing!
-- Message panels
QRC:

Message:  1024
<ce> While drawing your Fishing Net back in,
<ce> you managed to trawl up a _pearl_.

Message:  1025
<ce> While drawing your Fishing Net back in,
<ce> you managed to trawl up a _roottendrils_

Message:  1026
<ce> While drawing your Fishing Net back in,
<ce> you chanced upon a _map_
<ce> that was floating among the useless flotsum.

Message:  1033
<ce> While drawing your Fishing Net back in,
<ce> you chanced upon some _skin_.
<ce> that was floating among the useless flotsum.

Message:  1034
<ce> While drawing your Fishing Net back in,
<ce> you chanced upon a _mark_.
<ce> that was floating among the useless flotsum.

Message:  1035
<ce> While drawing your Fishing Net back in,
<ce> you chanced upon a _clothamulet_.
<ce> that was floating among the useless flotsum.


QBN:

Item _pearl_ pearl
Item _roottendrils_ root_tendrils
Item _map_ random_map
Item _skin_ skin
Item _mark_ mark
Item _clothamulet_ cloth_amulet


-- Quest start-up:
	reduce player fatigue by 10

_weakluc_ task:
	when attribute Luck is at least 0

_evenluc_ task:
	when attribute Luck is at least 40

_strongluc_ task:
	when attribute Luck is at least 60

_verystrongluc_ task:
	when attribute Luck is at least 80

_worstchanceluc_ task:
	when _weakluc_ and not _evenluc_

_evenchanceluc_ task:
	when _evenluc_ and not _strongluc_

_goodchanceluc_ task:
	when _strongluc_ and not _verystrongluc_

_bestchanceluc_ task:
	when _verystrongluc_

_bonusweak_ task:
	when _worstchanceluc_
	pick one of _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _1bonus_

_bonuseven_ task:
	when _evenchanceluc_
	pick one of _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_

_bonusgood_ task:
	when _goodchanceluc_
	pick one of _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_

_bonusbest_ task:
	when _bestchanceluc_
	pick one of _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _0bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_ _1bonus_

_0bonus_ task:
	end quest

_1bonus_ task:
	pick one of _pearlitem_ _pearlitem_ _roottendrilitem_ _roottendrilitem_ _mapitem_ _skinitem_ _skinitem_ _markitem_ _clothamuletitem_

_pearlitem_ task:
	say 1024
	get item _pearl_
	make _pearl_ permanent
	end quest

_roottendrilitem_ task:
	say 1025
	get item _roottendrils_
	make _roottendrils_ permanent
	end quest

_mapitem_ task:
	say 1026
	get item _map_
	make _map_ permanent
	end quest

_skinitem_ task:
	say 1033
	get item _skin_
	make _skin_ permanent
	end quest

_markitem_ task:
	say 1034
	get item _mark_
	make _mark_ permanent
	end quest

_clothamuletitem_ task:
	say 1035
	get item _clothamulet_
	make _clothamulet_ permanent
	end quest
